name: "Huttsplitter" blaster rifle
description: The "Huttsplitter" blaster rifle was the hand-crafted personal weapon of Tasu Leech, topboss of the criminal gang Kanjiklub. Leech brought it with him while trying to reclaim money owed to him by Han Solo, owner of the Baleen-class heavy freighter Eravana. He then used the weapon to defend himself from rathtars that attacked him and his men onboard Solo's vessel.
